prompt: Show that the SI base units of acceleration are m s^-2.

mark_scheme.criterion: States acceleration = change in velocity / time, gives units as (m s^-1) / s, and simplifies to m s^-2.

hints: Write the defining formula for acceleration.
Insert the base units of velocity and time, then simplify.
solution: Acceleration = (change in velocity) / time = (m s^-1) / s = m s^-2.
teacher_walkthrough: Velocity has base units m s^-1. Time has base unit s.
Dividing m s^-1 by s gives m s^-1 s^-1 = m s^-2.
